description: Get descriptive summaries for PubChem entities by ID. Supports assays (AID), genes (Gene ID), proteins (UniProt accession), and taxonomy (Tax ID). Up to 10 per call; identifiers past that are returned in unprocessed for a follow-up call.

entityType.description: Entity type. Determines ID format and returned fields.

identifiers.description:
Entity identifiers. A comma-joined string is split into one identifier per piece, with whitespace trimmed. The per-call cap is 10 pieces: the first 10 are looked up, and any past that are returned in unprocessed, in input order, and reported in cappedInputs. More than 1000 pieces in all fails the call. ID form depends on entityType:
- assay: AID, a positive integer, e.g. ["1000"]
- gene: NCBI Gene ID, a positive integer, e.g. ["1956"]
- protein: UniProt accession, e.g. ["P00533"]
- taxonomy: NCBI Taxonomy ID, a positive integer, e.g. ["9606"]
For assay, gene, and taxonomy, a piece that is not a positive integer written in digits is marked invalid and not looked up.

items.description: Entity identifier, or several joined with commas.

name: pubchem_get_summary

cappedInputs.description: Inputs that asked for more than their per-call cap, with the value requested and the value served. An ID batch lists the IDs past the cap in unprocessed. Omitted when every input was within its cap.

items.description: One input served at its per-call cap.

requested.description: Value requested: the page size, or the number of IDs in the batch.

unprocessed.description: ID batches only: IDs past the cap, listed in unprocessed in input order.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `too_many_identifiers`: Comma splitting yields more than 1000 identifier pieces. `invalid_identifier`: No identifier piece is usable: every piece is blank, or, for assay, gene, or taxonomy, not a positive integer. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery guidance when identifiers were invalid or not found.

requestedCount.description: Identifier pieces requested, counted after comma splitting.

summaries.description: Summary results, one per identifier piece looked up, in input order.

data.description: Entity summary data. Populated fields depend on entityType.

aid.description: Assay ID — present on assay summaries.

lastDataChange.description: Date the assay's data last changed, YYYY-MM-DD (assay summaries).

lineage.description: Taxonomic lineage ordered from the most inclusive rank to the most specific, e.g. ["Eukaryota", "Metazoa", "Chordata"] (taxonomy summaries). Ranks that do not apply to the entity are omitted.

method.description: Assay method as PubChem labels it, e.g. "confirmatory" (dose-response) or "screening" (assay summaries). Omitted when PubChem records none.

numActiveCompounds.description: Compounds (CIDs) the assay marked active (assay summaries).

numCompounds.description: Compounds (CIDs) tested (assay summaries). List them with pubchem_search_compounds searchType "assay" and activeOnly: false — its default lists only the actives.

targetCount.description: Number of targets PubChem lists for the assay (assay summaries).

targets.description: Assay targets, the first 25 PubChem lists (assay summaries); targetCount gives the full number.

anyOf.description: Numeric identifier (e.g. AID, Gene ID, Tax ID).

identifier.description: Queried identifier: a number for assay, gene, and taxonomy; the accession for protein; the piece as sent when invalid.

invalid.description: True when the identifier is not in the form entityType expects; it was not looked up. Omitted otherwise.

unprocessed.description: Identifier pieces past the per-call cap of 10, in input order, not looked up. Pass them in a follow-up call. Omitted when every piece was served.

title: Get Entity Summary
